steps.title: Define App Configuration
steps.description: Create app-meta.json containing application metadata for RemindMe Pro.

steps.title: Initialize Build Process Structure
steps.description: Establish build steps to outline the creation pipeline for RemindMe Pro.

steps.title: Configure Build dependencies and Gradle
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct plugins, SDK configurations (34), and target options.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with required permissions (alarms, notifications) and declare MainActivity and ReminderReceiver.

steps.title: Define Application Theme and Styles
steps.description: Create styles.xml inheriting from Android's built-in Material Theme to style standard SDK widgets.

steps.title: Define Application Colors
steps.description: Design a cohesive, pleasant color palette inside colors.xml for the user interface.

steps.title: Define Application Strings
steps.description: Create strings.xml containing general texts and localization keys.

steps.title: Design Dialog Layout for Adding Reminders
steps.description: Create dialog_add_reminder.xml layout specifying inputs for Title, Description, Date, and Time pickers.

steps.title: Design Card item for Reminders List
steps.description: Create layout reminder_item.xml representing visual attributes of individual reminders in the ListView.

steps.title: Design Main UI Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout containing customized action bar, empty-state text, and ListView.

steps.title: Design Visual Card backgrounds
steps.description: Create solid card background styles with appropriate margins and padding inside card_background.xml.

steps.title: Design Buttons and Status badges styling
steps.description: Create modern drawables for buttons and status badges to give the UI a clean material feeling.

steps.title: Create Reminder Model
steps.description: Write a clear, simple Java object for managing individual Reminders properties.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Write ReminderDatabaseHelper.java for persistent storage of user reminders locally on the device.

steps.title: Implement Alarm Broadcast Receiver
steps.description: Write ReminderReceiver.java extending BroadcastReceiver to catch scheduled alarms, notify the user, and auto-update SQLite status.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity logic
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java using pure Java 8. Manage ListView updating, Dialog handling, custom Adapters, AlarmManager triggers, and runtime permissions.

steps.title: Building RemindMe Pro
steps.description: Invoke gradle command to compile source code and generate the functional APK package for RemindMe Pro.
